test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

The lack of mutual bonding was conspicuous from their shody body language in the marriage party.
solution: The correct answer is **"shody."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct word is **"shoddy." ** • **"Shoddy"** means made of poor quality or inferior workmanship. (लापरवाही या घटिया माल से बना) • **Example**: *Those were **shoddy**__ goods.* • **"Shody"** is not a word in the English language. • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *"The lack of mutual bonding was conspicuous from their __**shoddy**__ body language in the marriage party."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "conspicuous,"** is a correct word meaning easily noticeable or standing out. (सुस्‍पष्‍ट, प्रकट, साफ़, प्रत्‍यक्ष) • **Option 3, "marriage,"** is a correct word referring to a union between two people. (पति-पत्‍नी होने की स्थिति; विवाह, शादी) • **Option 4, "mutual,"** is a correct word meaning shared or common between two or more parties. ((कोई मनोभाव या क्रिया) दोनों पक्षों द्वारा समान रूप से एक दूसरे के प्रति अनूभूत या संपादित, पारस्‍परिक, आपसी) 40:Td32, The correct answer is **"Denied."**
